note: Cases mirror the ORB_O_* diagnostics of resolve_orbital_reference that read only the call site and the upstream orbital. The payload is the LINT_CALL_SITES the input answers for an orbital reference (the unresolved program, the surviving traits, the reference with its declaration); expected findings are the compiler's on the same file (orb validate --json), cross-checked against `orb lint orbital-ref-config` for the set.
